Generate a production pixel-art sprite sheet, square image, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 separate icons, row-major. Flat solid magenta #FF00FF everywhere behind icons. No grid lines or cell borders. Equal 256x256 cells in a 1024x1024 composition. Each illustration is centered and fits in 70 percent of its cell, generous clear magenta gutters separating every icon. One simple bold icon-like illustration per cell. Actual Sega Master System Phantasy Star 1987 pixel art: hard square pixels, drawn as if each icon is just 28x22 logical pixels enlarged nearest-neighbour; thick continuous black outline, 6 to 10 flat colours, RGB channel values only 00/55/AA/FF. Large readable clusters; no tiny texture, no gradients, no antialiasing, no ground or shadows. Maintain the silhouette and distinguish every item at 32x24. No text, letters, numerals, faces, watermark or UI. Subjects occupy a landscape silhouette where possible. Do not connect separate cells.
